Soojin — finance here. Quick notes:
- Our virtual card provider flagged "Event/Meeting Venues" MCC as higher risk for automated virtual cards this quarter; the decline is usually MCC-related (merchant presented as "Hospitality Services" or a different descriptor).
- If the card is declined we have two short-term options: 1) retry with an override through the provider (requires vendor to accept a different descriptor/MCC), or 2) request a wire (ACH / domestic wire) from the vendor.
- For GL allocation: confirm Events (6-3000-Events). If any of the cost should be borne by Product marketing, we need an explicit billing tag at time of charge — we can retrocode but it slows reconciliation.

Action for Soojin: Confirm GL 6-3000-Events and whether we should ask vendor for wire details.
